_comment: v2 (#163). `prune`: unused v1 base tokens, in removal order. `ranked`: o200k tokens past the v1 base cut, best first, for English and for code. `tokens`: the extension slot_search.py chose; train_bpe.py removes the first len(tokens) `prune` tokens and puts `tokens` at their ids.
